title: Dalida's birth chart
metaDescription: Dalida's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 26.9° Capricorn. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Count only what the day settles, and earth still carries six of the nine placements whose signs are settled. An earth emphasis reads as patience with material reality — slow hands, durable results.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 26.9° Capricorn. That falls in the third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by Mercury in the classical scheme — an earth sign read through a cardinal season.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 13.4° Capricorn, Venus was at 3.8° Capricorn, Mars was at 20.2° Virgo. Read together: a mind that trusts the measured and the checked; taste for the substantial and the lasting; drive that grinds rather than flares.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: Jupiter to Pluto, a sextile with 0.9° of slack. A sextile is an offer rather than a given: available when it is reached for, quiet when it is not. Behind it, Mars sextile Pluto at 2.1°, and Uranus square Pluto at 2.6° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Sun opposes Pluto while both square Uranus. A t-square aims the whole axis at its apex planet; the tradition reads it as the chart’s standing assignment.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Two planets here sit in a sign the classical scheme scores. Jupiter in Virgo at 23.1° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Saturn in Aquarius at 5.9° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. The old table grades terrain, not talent — a placement in fall works uphill, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 6 earth, 1 air, 1 fire, 1 water; by modality, 5 cardinal, 3 mutable, 1 fixed. Earth counts what remains: the built, the kept, the finished. Promise weighs less than delivery. Jupiter, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Virgo into Libra during that day at the birthplace, travelling 13.5° between one midnight and the next. Half the day belongs to each sign, and the split falls at an unrecorded hour — so this page holds the Moon as a genuine unknown.
